message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Transfer of arcade business rights, then the defendant Li purchased three "打鱼机" (fishing game machines) each with 8 seats, placed in arcade, providing gambling venue and equipment. The machines have gambling function. He operated for three days, illegal profit 150 yuan. He was caught, then self-reported.

Thus crime: operating a gambling venue, i.e., "开设赌场". In Chinese criminal law, operating a gambling establishment is "开设赌场". The list includes "开设赌场". So charge is "开设赌场". Also possibly "赌博" but the list includes "赌博" as a separate label. In examples, they used "赌博" for case where someone organized gambling activities (setting up gambling machine). Example: earlier "赌博" case: "项某多次召集...以“炸鸡”的方式进行赌博活动". They labeled "赌博". Another example: "开设赌场" used for case where someone set up a gambling hall. The difference: "赌博" is the act of gambling, while "开设赌场" is establishing a casino. Here Li set up gambling machines in arcade, providing gambling venue. That is akin to "开设赌场". The earlier example: "开设赌场" used for case where someone rented premises for gambling machines. So likely "开设赌场". Also maybe "赌博" but we need choose best.

The list includes both "赌博" and "开设赌场". Which to use? The fact says "为他人提供赌博场所及用具". That's establishing a gambling venue. So "开设赌场". Use that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]开设赌场<eoa>
